initiative_library.name: Sustainable IT Framework (Phases 1–3)
initiative_library.what: RGESN maturity assessment, Sopht GreenOps platform, baseline dashboards, targeted trainings, scenario analysis, action plan, GDSA case study, monitoring, advisory and communications (deliverables D1–D10).

initiative_library.name: Carbon emissions baselining & supplier-attributed monitoring
initiative_library.what: Scope 1/2/3 baseline at contract start, refreshed each FY; spend-allocated supplier emissions; annual NHS-specific emissions dashboard; independent verification.

initiative_library.name: Net Zero Leadership training
initiative_library.what: Interactive workshops with the Centre for Sustainable Healthcare for board-level NHS leaders.

initiative_library.name: Health & Nature online module
initiative_library.what: 30-minute online module on nature and health for NHS staff.

initiative_library.name: Mandatory Sustainability & Green IT training (Infosys workforce)
initiative_library.what: Mandatory 4-hour training on Infosys Lex for the full contract workforce.

initiative_library.name: CSH Green Space & Health training course
initiative_library.what: Oracle funds NHS staff on Green Health Routes to attend a 6-hour CSH course plus workshops.

initiative_library.name: Data centre efficiency programme
initiative_library.what: PUE 1.3 by Jan 2030; ISO 50001/14001; Climate Neutral Data Centre Pact; 100% renewable data centres.

initiative_library.name: Energy-efficient (green) coding across FWS
initiative_library.what: Developer training on sustainable coding and Green IT awareness for all Infosys developers on the contract.

initiative_library.name: Nudge Programme — Workforce Sustainable Behaviour app
initiative_library.what: Voluntary app nudging NHS staff to cut commuting, travel and paper footprint.

initiative_library.name: Commitment to renewables
initiative_library.what: Partners prioritise renewable electricity; avoid ~150 tCO2e scope 2 per year across 15 years.

initiative_library.name: Supplier emissions transparency
initiative_library.what: Supplier screening and ESG assessments; target 50% cut in scope 2 & 3 supply-chain emissions.

initiative_library.name: IT equipment recovery (Design for Environment)
initiative_library.what: Oracle recovers 100% of data-centre IT equipment, <0.1% to landfill.

initiative_library.name: Social Value Scorecard & Oracle Carbon Calculator
initiative_library.what: Periodic scorecard; OCI carbon calculator tracking 50% of emissions within 5 years.

initiative_library.name: Green Health Routes (5) and Oracle donation
initiative_library.what: Oracle funds and resources five community biodiverse green spaces / NHS green health routes in deprived areas; £85,000 donation.

initiative_library.name: Community Innovation Fund
initiative_library.what: £25,000 every other year across five regions for workforce, wellbeing and sustainability projects.

initiative_library.name: Reforestation donation
initiative_library.what: One-off separately funded reforestation donation.

initiative_library.name: FWS Ambassador Programme (apprenticeships)
initiative_library.what: 80 Level 3/4 apprentices from under-represented / deprived groups providing on-site FWS support; ~10% progress to Level 4.

initiative_library.name: E-Waste Pipeline for prison leavers
initiative_library.what: 11 prison leavers / ex-offenders trained and employed refurbishing devices for the device prescribing programme.

initiative_library.name: Device Prescribing Pilot Programme
initiative_library.what: Primary-care referrals to volunteer digital consultants who prescribe refurbished devices, connectivity and access to the National Digital Inclusion Network.

initiative_library.name: Springboard (NHS-Tech online learning)
initiative_library.what: Certified tech training and learning hours on Infosys Springboard for high-barrier resident / patient groups.

initiative_library.name: Work-Ready Clubs & Maker Zones
initiative_library.what: Weekly after-school clubs for 16–18 year-olds; two Maker Zones in the North West.

initiative_library.name: Springpod virtual work experience
initiative_library.what: Live and pre-recorded virtual work experience for NHS / NHS-tech settings.

initiative_library.name: Tech Returners programme
initiative_library.what: 12-week online reskilling, mentoring and job-placement support for experienced professionals returning after a career break.

initiative_library.name: Young learners in further education (Sutton Trust + MAT)
initiative_library.what: Cash donations and health-tech learning content via Sutton Trust Online and a Multi-Academy Trust; summer schools.

initiative_library.name: Accessibility review
initiative_library.what: Quarterly accessibility review.

initiative_library.name: FWS free of modern slavery (MSAT ≥80%)
initiative_library.what: Bi-annual Home Office MSAT ≥80% (Green RAG); top-3 suppliers complete MSAT; policies, audits, training.

initiative_library.name: Unseen NHS Clinical Modern Slavery Detection training & Learning Academy
initiative_library.what: Infosys funds Unseen (Hope for Justice) to deliver clinical detection training and an awareness academy for NHS staff.

initiative_library.name: Oracle × Unseen e-learning for NHS procurement staff
initiative_library.what: Two additional modules for NHS procurement staff.

initiative_library.name: Community support grant to Unseen
initiative_library.what: Grant supporting Unseen technology initiatives and Infosys–Unseen partnership programmes.

initiative_library.name: Innovation research grant / bursary
initiative_library.what: Research grant / bursary via NHSBSA Student Services.

initiative_library.name: Five modern slavery PhDs
initiative_library.what: Fund five PhDs with a university selected by Infosys; competitive call via the Governance Committee.

initiative_library.name: PhD implementation fund
initiative_library.what: Fund to implement, test and verify the PhD recommendations.

initiative_library.name: Modern Slavery Awareness Champion
initiative_library.what: Awareness champion and social-scientist support.

initiative_library.name: Programme governance (SV Director, committee, reporting, travel, comms)
initiative_library.what: Social Value Director, quarterly Governance Committee, dashboards, travel and communication artefacts.

initiative_library.name: SV2 subject-matter expert (programme support)
initiative_library.what: UK-based Senior Consultant supporting SV2 delivery.

initiative_library.name: SV3 subject-matter expert (programme support)
initiative_library.what: Consultant supporting SV3 delivery.
